preview.title: NVIDIA Board Reinstates Jensen Huang as President, CEO and Board Director
preview.description: NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA) today announced that effective immediately, Jensen Huang has been reinstated as President and Chief Executive Officer and as a member of the Board.
